description:
Update the inventory safety stock settings for 'Amoxicillin 500mg' in HospitalRun. The supplier has updated their terms, requiring adjustments to our inventory parameters.

1. Navigate to the Inventory section.
2. Locate the item 'Amoxicillin 500mg'.
3. Update the Reorder Point to '150'.
4. Update the Price to '12.50'.
5. Save the changes.
